items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: She influenced Fletcher, she let Joe come in the band.

ctx.x: He played the shows. He played in Lou Leslie's Blackbirds one year, and other shows. Then there was Luke. Luke, he was interested in pool. He was one of the best pool players. He could beat the world's best pool shark, too. But he was a good trumpet player. But he wasn't interested in music. Then there was Joe Smith.

Now, Joe couldn't read much, but he had a nice, beautiful tone. And Fletcher's wife liked Joe, the baby. He was -- all this was trumpet, now. She and Russell Smith broke up. She married Fletcher. But Joe still hung around and all like that. She influenced Fletcher, she let Joe come in the band.
Well, I was so busy, I had never -- I had seen her
